title: CameraEvent
description: Event produced by an edge agent (Standard Vision Engine, optional AI Engine or system health). The `id` is generated at the source and makes uploads idempotent. Mirrors the `camera_events` table of the central server.

id.description: Event UUID generated on the edge device

source.description: standard = no-AI vision engine; ai = optional AI engine; system = camera/device health

track_id.description: Temporary, camera- and session-scoped track id. Never a personal identifier.
